rules.note: Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 without extended context compact at the 200K boundary (with [1m] they use the 1M rule)
models with a native 1M window compact at about 967K tokens by default

claude-code.otherwise_note: other models compact when the conversation reaches the model's context limit
claude-code.caveats: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 makes 1M models compact at 200K; cloud sessions compact as they approach the limit; unrecognized model IDs assume 200K.

codex.note: with model_auto_compact_token_limit unset, the limit is 90% of the resolved context window; a configured value is clamped to that 90%
